MALACCA STRAIT
Singapore Straits
Indonesia
01° 04.19' N
103° 40.70' E
payload.summary:
Duty crew onboard a bulk carrier noticed six robbers armed
with knives in the engine room. Alarm raised and crew
mustered. Seeing the crew alertness, the robbers escaped
with the stolen ship’s engine spares. The incident was
reported to VTIS, who then instructed the vessel to proceed
to the anchorage for inspection by the Coast Guard.
